question: Where were the 2006 Winter Olympics held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Turin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2006 Winter Olympics**, officially known as the **XX Olympic Winter Games** and commonly known as **Torino 2006**, were held in **Turin**, **Italy**.
 
• The event took place from **February 10 to February 26, 2006**, marking the second time **Italy** hosted the **Winter Olympics**, following the **1956 Games** in Cortina d'A
